summary: Iteration 10 - BACKEND-ONLY regression after a pure frontend responsive redesign (Layout.jsx mobile drawer, index.css table utilities, pages/*.jsx sizing). Cleared db.login_attempts first. Ran existing suites serially: (1) tests/iter9_test.py + tests/iter7_test.py + tests/iter8_test.py -> 80/80 PASS. This covers the explicitly requested health scope: GET /api/auth/me without cookie -> 401; POST /api/auth/login admin@wolfsmind.it/Admin2026! -> 200 with httpOnly access_token/refresh_token cookies and password_hash/_id stripped; wrong password -> 401; brute-force lockout 5x401 then 429; and 200 + no raw mongo _id for /api/tesserati, /api/ricevute, /api/dashboard, /api/calendario, /api/verbali, /api/libro-soci, /api/compensi, /api/compensi/erogati, /api/abbonamenti, /api/tipi-pacchetto, /api/lezioni, /api/movimenti, /api/movimenti/riepilogo-mensile, /api/report/bilancio, /api/organizzazione, /api/users, counters CRUD + authz, portale token flows and PDF smoke (%PDF). (2) tests/backend_test.py + tests/edge_test.py -> 101 passed / 3 failed - EXACTLY the same 3 known failures as iteration 9, none new: 2 environmental email-proxy failures (backend.err.log confirms 'Email failed: 429 rate_limited' and 'Email failed: 422 undeliverable_recipient' from Resend, app maps to 502) and 1 pre-existing backlog authz gap (tecnico can PATCH its own slot tecnico_id -> 200 instead of 403). Conclusion: zero backend regressions from the responsive frontend work. Frontend not tested (out of scope per request).

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING backlog (iter 5-10): a tecnico can reassign its own slot to another tecnico_id and receives 200 instead of 403.
Environmental only: Resend proxy returns 429 rate_limited / 422 undeliverable_recipient -> app returns 502. Causes 2 backend_test.py failures; not a code regression.

action_items: No backend action required - responsive frontend redesign caused zero backend regressions.
Backlog only: add authz check in PATCH /api/calendario/{sid} so a tecnico cannot reassign tecnico_id to another user.
critical_code_review_comments: Login lockout is still keyed on email only (server.py) - allows account-lockout DoS; consider IP/backoff combination.
Email failures surface as 502 with no retry/queue; consider distinguishing 429 (retryable) from 422 (permanent) in the API response so the UI can message the user correctly.

success_rate.backend: 100% on requested scope (80/80 iter7+8+9); wider suites 101/104 with 2 environmental email failures + 1 known backlog authz gap

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only, created and deleted by the existing suites (TEST_ prefixed tecnici/tesserati/slots). db.login_attempts cleared before the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run serially: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/iter9_test.py tests/iter7_test.py tests/iter8_test.py -q -n 0 (all pass), then tests/backend_test.py tests/edge_test.py (expect the same 3 known failures). Clear db.login_attempts before runs. Frontend UI has NOT been exercised by an agent since iteration 5 - the new responsive Layout drawer, portale tesserato UI, libro-soci PDF button, verbali/compensi and admin/numerazione tab all still need a Playwright pass at 390px/820px/1920px when frontend testing is authorised.
